## Excessive AI Credit Charges in Adobe…
Excessive AI Credit Charges in Adobe After Effects Beta   
  
I am a paying Adobe subscriber, and I find the credit consumption system of the AI Assistant in After Effects Beta extremely frustrating.  
  
I was charged approximately 200 credits for creating a 30-second YouTube Short using existing video footage, even though I explicitly instructed the assistant not to use generative AI.  
  
Later, another 50 credits were deducted simply for making a comment to the assistant, without requesting any content generation.  
  
I find it unacceptable that even basic conversations with an AI assistant can consume so many credits, especially when I am already paying for an Adobe subscription.

results.title: Adobe’s AI Assistant Turns Creative Cloud Into a Full Production Workflow
results.content:
Instead of treating every image, video, design, and edit as a separate task, Adobe's creative agent manages the project across apps. The assistants handle the work, while Firefly keeps the project's assets, context, and history together.

## Your Apps Hired a Manager

Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, and Frame.io now share one assistant instead of each having its own separate AI.

Adobe’s creative agent sits across your apps. It takes a goal you describe and works out the steps across whichever tools the job actually touches.

For years your software did exactly what you told it and nothing else. You gave it one instruction, it performed one action, and you moved to the next instruction yourself. The agent changes that relationship. [...] # Creative Cloud Stopped Waiting for Instructions

### How Adobe’s creative agent handles the setup, organization, and production tasks around the work you create

Creating something with AI used to involve a lot of starting over.

You generated an image, downloaded it, re-uploaded assets, explained your project again, and rebuilt the same context every time you wanted to continue working.

The problem is, the project was a collection of exports, references, screenshots, notes, and assets scattered across different tools.

Now your creative context has a place to live, so the project stays intact instead of resetting every time you switch tools. [...] Speed goes up, and the judgment stays human. The assistant moves faster through the production work, and you keep the say over what is good, what ships, and what gets thrown out.

You’re spending less of your day on execution, and more of it on the direction only you can give.

results.title: Revolutionary Adobe Firefly AI Assistant Launches, Transforming Creative Workflows Across Apps
results.content:
## FAQs

Q1: What exactly is the Adobe Firefly AI Assistant?  
The Adobe Firefly AI Assistant is an intelligent agent that operates within Creative Cloud applications. It uses natural language prompts to execute tasks, orchestrate workflows between different apps like Photoshop and Premiere, and suggest context-aware edits, acting as a collaborative partner in the creative process.

Q2: How is this different from the existing Firefly generative AI?  
While the core Firefly service is primarily for generating images, text effects, and videos from prompts, the Firefly AI Assistant focuses on workflow automation and task execution. It uses AI to control and navigate existing software features rather than solely creating new assets from scratch. [...] San Francisco, CA – April 30, 2025 – Adobe has officially launched the public beta for its highly anticipated Firefly AI Assistant, a transformative agent designed to execute complex creative tasks by seamlessly orchestrating actions across the entire Creative Cloud suite. This launch marks a significant evolution from last October’s “Project Moonlight” preview, positioning Adobe at the forefront of practical, application-integrated artificial intelligence for creative professionals. The assistant promises to reduce friction in learning sophisticated tools and accelerate production timelines.

## Adobe Firefly AI Assistant Enters Public Beta [...] ## Adobe Firefly AI Assistant Enters Public Beta

Adobe’s Firefly AI Assistant will become available to users worldwide in the coming weeks through a public beta program. The company developed this tool to function as an intelligent collaborator within applications like Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Illustrator, and Adobe Express. Consequently, users can describe a desired outcome in natural language, and the assistant will manage the necessary steps across different software. For example, a user could request, “Create a social media banner from this product photo and prepare three size variations,” and the assistant would handle cropping, asset optimization, and file management.
